about: English specs and build status of the SCS-batch decisions, by decision-page row. Same format as docs/build-specs.json.

parts.spec: IWD/SCS progression without the +6 save bonus: level 1 deals 1d4 magic damage + blind for 1 round (save vs. spell negates secondary effect); level 2 deals 1d6 fire damage + -1 AC/THAC0 for 1 round; level 3 deals 1d8 magic + 1d3 fire damage; level 4 deals 1d10 magic damage + blind for 4 rounds; level 5 deals 1d12 magic damage + stun for 3 rounds; level 7+ deals 2d8 magic damage + hold for 13 rounds (Free Action protects).
The created meteor weapon (MELFMET.ITM) has +2 enchantment instead of +5.
Save vs. breath instead of vs. spell for half, no penalty.
Damage capped at 12d6 (abilities above level 12 removed; level 12 ability deals 12d6).
Blocked for later: instant-equipping shapeshift tokens and revised forms require custom form items/animations and a shapeshift token system not yet built.
Lowers magic resistance by 30% + 1% per caster level (was 10% + 1% per level), and no longer bypasses spell protections (power level restored to 5 on magic-resistance reduction effects).
School changed from Conjuration to Enchantment (Invoker exclusion 0x0080 instead of Diviner 0x0100) on the spell and its scrolls.
School changed from Conjuration to Enchantment on the spell and its scrolls; creatures under Free Action are immune.
Mantle stays in the slot (no Prismatic Mantle replacement) and protects against weapons up to +3 enchantment (was +2).
Projected images (PROJIMAG.SPL) have quick-slot items (buttons 9, 11, 12) and innate abilities (button 13) disabled.
Cacofiend stays in the slot; the summoned fiend matches caster alignment: Bone Fiend (baatezu) for lawful casters, Nabassu (tanar'ri) for chaotic casters, and 50/50 for neutral casters.
Undead, golems, animated swords, and air/earth/fire elementals are immune.
Improved Mantle stays in the slot (no Moment of Prescience replacement) and protects against weapons up to +4 enchantment (was +3).
School changed from Conjuration to Enchantment on the spell and its scrolls; affects a single target (projectile 1) instead of an area.
Simulacra (SIMULACR.SPL) have quick-slot items (buttons 9, 11, 12) disabled while keeping innate abilities (button 13) enabled.
Later (needs EEex): filter simulacrum innate abilities dynamically by the simulacrum's effective level.
The summoned fiend matches caster alignment: Cornugon (baatezu) for lawful casters, Glabrezu (tanar'ri) for chaotic casters, and 50/50 for neutral casters.
Explosion projectile affects only enemies (matching the NPC symbol projectile).
Explosion projectile affects only enemies; creatures under Free Action are immune.
Symbol, Fear stays in the slot (no Symbol of Weakness replacement); explosion projectile affects only enemies.
Protects against weapons up to +6 enchantment (was +5).
The gated fiend matches caster alignment: Pit Fiend (baatezu) for lawful casters, Balor (tanar'ri) for chaotic casters, and 50/50 for neutral casters.
School changed from Conjuration to Enchantment on the spell and its scrolls.
Blocked for later: instant-equipping shapeshift tokens and revised forms require custom form items/animations and a shapeshift token system not yet built.
Casting time reduced from 9 to 6; payload affects only enemies and a successful save vs. spell halves the damage instead of negating it.
Duration increased to 1 round per caster level up to 11 rounds/bolts (projectiles 85..91); outdoor-only restriction and vanilla 2d8 + 1d8/level damage stay.
Restricted to clerics/paladins (priest usability word at 0x20 set to 0x8000); AC bonus increased from +2 to +4.

Deals 3d4 crushing damage (6d4 against undead) instead of 1d4.
Gate stays in the slot; the gated fiend matches caster alignment: Pit Fiend for lawful casters, Balor for chaotic casters, and 50/50 for neutral casters.
Later: good (and possibly neutral) priests may receive a separate summon.

Summon Insects, Insect Plague, and Creeping Doom: per-round save vs. breath against spell failure (at 0 / -2 / -2); Fire Shields (Red, Blue, Aura of Flaming Death) remove and block them; Stoneskin holds off the secondary effects while skins remain; immunity to normal weapons protects; undead are immune; magic resistance and Dispel Magic do not help. Zone of Sweet Air stays vanilla.
Later: additional logical counters (e.g. wind spells).

Blindness is moved to schoolless subspells (so True Sight's school-based illusion removal does not dispel it) and depends on the save vs. spell (+3): on a failed save, humanoids die and targets suffer permanent blindness; on a successful save, targets are blinded for 3 rounds.
